sentences.text: During the pendency of the petition, both petitioner and respondent No.2 appeared through their counsels and filed a joint compromise application along with affidavits under Section 320 read with Section 482 of I.P.C for seeking permission to compound the offence.
It is submitted that divorce has already granted and the entire alimony amount paid to respondent No.2.
Respondent No.2 present before this Court and submits that she has received the entire alimony amount.

In view of the judgment rendered by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Gian Singh vs State of Punjab and another (2012) 10 SCC 303, the parties are settled their issues and the Court can quash the criminal proceedings.

entities.text: Gian Singh vs State of Punjab and another (2012) 10 SCC 303
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A.No.1/2023 is allowed.
Parties are permitted to compound their offence.
Consequently, both criminal petitions are allowed.

The criminal proceedings against petitioner Nos.1 to 3 in C.C.No.53/2019 pending on the file of IV Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC,
Mysuru arising out of crime No.34/2018 registered by the Udayagiri police are hereby quashed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Respondent No.2 present before this Court and submits that she has received the entire alimony amount.
Accordingly, I.A.No.1/2023 is allowed.
Parties are permitted to compound their offence.
Consequently, both criminal petitions are allowed.
The criminal proceedings against petitioner Nos.1 to 3 in C.C.No.53/2019 pending on the file of IV Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC,
Mysuru arising out of crime No.34/2018 registered by the Udayagiri police are hereby quashed.
